name: io_uring Restricted for Unprivileged Users
description:
Ensures kernel.io_uring_disabled is 1 (only members of kernel.io_uring_group may create io_uring instances) or 2 (io_uring disabled). io_uring has been the source of many kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities. Kernels older than 6.6 (and distributions that have not backported the switch) do not provide the setting and fail.
Required sudo rule (remedy only): allow user lea to run ONLY this exact command without a password: lea ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /sbin/sysctl -w kernel.io_uring_disabled=2
